about.title: Frontend Software Developer
about.bio: Software Engineer with more than two years of experience building web applications. Specialized in React and TypeScript, I have contributed to international projects for U.S. clients and currently collaborate on digital solutions for major Spanish companies such as El Corte Inglés. I am particularly interested in building robust, maintainable interfaces with a strong focus on user experience.
